finding.rationale: Adding ایسا حرف ہے جو supplies an explicit masculine antecedent for روکتا ہے, removes ambiguity, and preserves the exact grammar claim. Cited Arabic labels such as ناہیہ do not by themselves force feminine Urdu predication when حرف is understood. Feminine reference can also be natural under a different understood antecedent; no mass normalization is justified.
